title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: probesequenc
text:
probe sequence
probe sequence
(definition)
Definition:
The list of locations which a method for
open addressing
produces as alternatives in case of a
collision
.
See also
hash table
,
collision resolution scheme
,
clustering
,
uniform hashing
.
